title: Exactly as described
text: Exactly as described. This stool is exactly as pictured and described. It's sturdy, well put together and will last a long time. I aged it and beat it up to make it look old and it turned out beautifully. Very easy to work with.

product_metadata.title: International Concepts 24-Inch Saddle Seat Stool, Unfinished
features: Strength Group: B6 (same group as maple)
description: Offer a warm, inviting look to your kitchen, dining room, bar, or lounge with this solid wood barstool from International Concepts. This beautifully crafted stool is part of a high-quality collection of wood furniture that boosts a traditional and elegant look that will easily complement any décor. Parawood – a hardwood known for its durable, strong, and environmentally friendly nature – is used to craft this attractive and durable stool. Pair with one of the wide variety of solid wood tables from International Concepts and create the perfect gathering place in your home!
